resources.title: Resources
resources.failed_to_load_users: Could not load active users. Close and reopen the dialog to retry.
resources.no_active_users: No active users available. Create or approve a user first.
resources.android_setup_intro: Use the VPN client built into Android. No extra app, computer, or USB cable is needed.
resources.android_step_certificate: 1. Download the certificate, then import it under Android Settings > Security > Install certificate > VPN & app user certificate.
resources.android_step_connection: 2. Open Android Settings > Network & Internet > VPN > Add VPN. Select IKEv2/IPsec RSA, then enter:
resources.android_step_ca: 3. If Android asks for a trusted CA, download and import the certificate below.
resources.android_ca_note: The client certificate already includes the CA chain. Some Android versions require a separate CA import.
resources.android_security_note: The .p12 contains your private key and its import password is shown here. Download only over HTTPS or a fully trusted private network; HTTP can expose both in transit. Delete the .p12 after importing; never share it.
resources.android_oem_note: Android menus vary by manufacturer. If IKEv2/IPsec RSA is absent from the built-in VPN list, native certificate VPN is unavailable on that device.

access.title: Access Rules
access.guidance_desc: Deny exclusions are evaluated first, followed by direct individual grants, then inherited user group rules. All traffic outside allowed destinations is dropped by default.
access.subject: Subject (Who)
access.select_subject_placeholder: Choose an existing user or group

users.title: Users
users.create_user_desc: Create a local account with email and password without OIDC.

dns.title: DNS Engine
dns.magic_dns_desc: Internal domain suffix automatically assigned to peer hostnames.
dns.upstream_desc: Public DNS servers used to resolve external internet queries.
dns.custom_overrides_desc: Map specific internal domain names directly to private server IPs
dns.override_exact_note: Overrides match exact FQDNs. Subdomains (such as www.) are not included automatically unless explicitly specified or using wildcards (e.g. *.corp.internal).

server.title: Server Settings
server.managed_config_applied: Saved to disk and synchronized with the live VPN daemon.
server.lifetimes_desc: Set maximum session duration and automated key renewal intervals.
server.max_session_hint: Forces client devices to re-authenticate against your identity directory after this period.
server.idle_timeout_hint: Automatically terminates idle tunnels when no traffic flows. (Set 0 to disable)
server.roaming_desc: Enable seamless network transitions and firewall bypass.
server.mobike_hint: Allows devices to seamlessly switch between Wi-Fi and mobile networks (4G/5G) without losing the VPN connection.
server.force_encap_hint: Bypasses strict firewalls in hotels, airports, or public Wi-Fi networks that block standard VPN traffic.
server.fragmentation_hint: Splits large handshake packets to prevent connection failures caused by network MTU limits.
server.health_desc: Detect disconnected peers and automatically reclaim virtual IP addresses.
server.endpoint_desc: Public connection address and TCP packet optimization.
server.public_hostname_hint: Address clients connect to (for example 192.168.101.159 on your local network).
server.gateway_identity_hint: Must match the identity in the VPN server certificate. May differ from the endpoint address; changing it can reissue the gateway certificate.
server.load_failed: Could not load gateway settings. Check your connection and reload this page.
server.saved_not_applied: Settings were stored, but the VPN gateway has not applied them yet.
server.mss_clamping_hint: Prevents loading freezes on mobile data or low-MTU networks. Default: 1360.
server.ciphers_desc: Select security compliance standard and native client compatibility level.
server.preset_balanced_desc: AES-256-GCM, SHA-384. Compatible with native Apple & Windows 10/11.
server.preset_custom_desc: Manual fine-grained proposal strings for advanced compliance.
server.applied_success: Settings applied successfully with zero downtime!

logs.title: System Logs
logs.host_control_unavailable: Host strongSwan mode: start, stop and restart must be performed on the host. VPN policy and sessions remain manageable here.

confirm.delete_rule_description: Delete the {action} rule for {subject} → {target}? Gateway policy will change immediately.
confirm.delete_dns_description: Remove {name} → {target}? Internal DNS queries will no longer use this record.
confirm.delete_group_description: Delete {name}? Memberships will be removed. Groups referenced by access rules cannot be deleted.
confirm.delete_subnet_description: Delete {name} ({cidr})? This is only possible when no devices or policies reference it.
confirm.delete_provider_description: Delete {name}? Users bound to this provider may need another sign-in method; linked providers are protected by the server.
confirm.revoke_description: Revoke {name}? The certificate will be permanently invalidated and its VPN tunnel disconnected.
confirm.disconnect_description: Terminate the current IKEv2 session {name}? The client may reconnect automatically.
confirm.grant_admin_description: Give {name} ({email}) full SwanPanel administrator privileges, including user management, credentials and VPN policies?
confirm.remove_admin_description: Remove administrator privileges from {name} ({email})? Their existing session will immediately lose admin access.
confirm.create_admin_description: Create {name} ({email}) with full system administrator permissions? This account can manage users, certificates and VPN policies.
confirm.reject_user_description: Reject {name} ({email})? Their pending registration will be deleted.
confirm.approve_user_description: Approve {name} ({email}) and activate access to SwanPanel?
confirm.delete_user_description: Delete {name} ({email})? Their devices will be revoked before removal, and this action cannot be undone.
confirm.restart_gateway_description: Restart strongSwan? Active VPN tunnels may disconnect and reconnect during the operation.
confirm.stop_gateway_description: Stop strongSwan? All current VPN sessions will disconnect and new connections will fail until it is started again.
confirm.rotate_ca_description: Replace the current Root CA with {name}? Previously installed trust chains will no longer be valid. Confirm only if this is an empty installation.
confirm.create_rule_description: Apply {action} from {subject} to {target}? This changes network access immediately and may permit or interrupt VPN traffic.
confirm.apply_advanced_description: Advanced strongSwan settings may interrupt active tunnels or leave gateway policy pending if validation fails. Review the JSON before continuing.
